storyboard.title: Preserve metric identity from comparison record to manuscript

central_message.text: The supplied comparison records ground an identity-preserving transformation: resolve each numeric leaf by run and JSON pointer, join it to dataset, method and uncertainty metadata, and reuse that binding in prose, tables and vector heatmaps.

problem.text: Identity must survive aggregation: a numeric value alone does not specify its dataset, method, split protocol or uncertainty definition.

consequence.text: Testable expectation: identity-bound rendering reduces dataset-method misattribution and stale numeric reporting relative to an otherwise matched unbound transformation.
consequence.test: Compare bound and unbound transformations on the same source matrix and reporting tasks. Inject pointer deletion, record reordering, value updates and label swaps; independently score incorrect identities, stale quantities, uncertainty-definition errors and rejection of invalid bindings. Hold content, layout and review budget fixed. No A/B gain is supplied.

inputs: Completed run fixture-run-001 and its summary records for Breast cancer, Wine and Digits
Metric catalog containing run IDs, JSON pointers and exact numeric values
Dataset and method labels, stratified held-out split protocol and across-split SD definition
Compiler-derived visual and argumentative paragraph positions, when available
outputs: Dataset-method comparison cells with exact metric bindings
Prose quantities and vector heatmap cells resolved from the same bindings
Placement checks based on actual compiled page positions
boundary_conditions: Engineering qualification: the supplied measurements establish comparison inputs, not a novel scientific method or submission-readiness result.
Preprocessing is fit on training data only under the supplied stratified held-out protocol.
SD describes variation across random train-test splits with reused source samples, not independent populations.

The supplied catalog contains no original visual candidates, independent review reports, asset-binding manifest or compiled page-position records; their successful validation cannot be depicted as observed.
Per-split records are described in the requested mechanism but are not included in the supplied summary catalog.
Reported interval endpoints must remain unchanged; their construction and confidence level require documentation before interpreting them as inferential confidence intervals.

key_change.explanation: The transformation carries the source identity alongside the quantity instead of reconstructing identity from a displayed number. The dominant visual zoom should expose this concrete join and its shared binding across representations; structural traceability is distinct from a measured reduction in reporting errors.

story_context.goal: Render an identity-preserving scientific mechanism diagram from supplied benchmark records, keeping numeric values bound to their dataset, method and uncertainty definitions.
story_context.caption: Scientific tension: aggregate values alone lose their dataset, method and uncertainty identities when transformed into visual and narrative representations. The implemented mechanism retains actual dataset-method-split records, binds each reported quantity to its exact metric pointer and identity, creates complete comparison tables and vector heatmaps, and checks actual paragraph-to-visual compiled page positions. Explain the numeric binding and join mechanism with a concrete observed comparison cell, not a directory of generic agents. The A/B scientific value of the framework is an explicitly testable expectation, not a measured gain. This engineering qualification demonstrates actual comparison coverage only; it is not a novel scientific method or acceptance claim.

method.problem: Dataset-method identities and uncertainty definitions must survive conversion from a real comparison matrix into prose and visuals.
method.method: Metric leaves retain run ID, JSON pointer and numeric identity; table cells carry exact metric tokens with dataset and method labels. Actual completed compiler output supplies visual-page and argumentative paragraph-page positions. The existing implementation refuses missing metric pointers and stale bindings. Independent reviews assess observed original candidates.
